constraints: Use ONLY the supplied files. No browsing, no new Shelem facts, no unlisted repo/stack assumptions. A needed-but-absent fact is BLOCKED_WITH_RESOLVER, never invented.
Python 3.10+ standard library only. No third-party installs. No claims of tests or runs not actually performed; report commands with stdout/exit code only if run.

EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REQUIRED_NO_BLEND: creating a session without a named full profile must fail loudly. No silent combining of floor/award/slam/target across source profiles. Changing an option creates a new recorded composite profile, never overwrites a source profile.

Every option carries provenance (compendium section + S# source IDs), legal values, compatibility, and status SUPPORTED, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED_UNSPECIFIED. Unavailable options appear as disabled-with-reason, never as playable.
G0-settled (facts below) are implemented as specified. Everything else contested stays per-compendium with disagreements preserved.
